Hi Emily — thanks for taking the demo today. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we have alignment:

1) What we covered (audit logging focus)
- Admin activity logs: user/role changes, permission grants, console admin actions (timestamped)
- API logs: request/response metadata, requestor identity, endpoint, payload size, latency
- Exportability: secure export to S3 (JSON/CSV), scheduled exports, and on-demand exports for audits
- Immutability options: WORM-style retention via object-lock in Dedicated/Private + append-only system logs in hosted; cryptographic signing of audit bundles available for enterprise customers
- Retention: retention policies configurable per-tenant; default hosted retention is 90 days for raw logs, with aggregated audit snapshots retained per contract

Hi all — quick technical response and recommended config for Acme. High level: we support the export and immutability options requested; details below.

1) Immutability / non-repudiation- Hosted (standard): append-only system and API logs with 90-day raw retention. We provide signed audit snapshots on request (HMAC) for tamper-evidence, but hosted customers cannot enforce S3 object-lock on Redwood-managed buckets. For customers with strict WORM requirements we recommend Dedicated or Private deployment where the customer's storage (S3 with Object Lock) can be configured.

2) Export paths & formats- Supported formats: JSON (canonical schema), CSV for quick inspection, and gzipped bundles for large exports. Sample rows/fields are included in the attached CSV.
- Delivery: push to customer-owned S3 via role-based access / pre-signed PUTs, or deliver signed bundles via our secure transfer endpoint.

3) Retention & archival- Default hosted retention: 90 days raw, 1 year aggregated snapshots.
- Dedicated/Private: configurable retention windows; we can implement object-locked exports and longer system retention per contract. For legal hold scenarios we recommend scheduled exported snapshots to an Object Lock-enabled bucket under customer control.

4) Recommended configuration for Acme (based on today’s ask)- Use Dedicated or Private with customer-managed S3 and Object Lock enabled (Compliance mode) for immutable storage.
- Enable signed audit bundles (HMAC) for every exported snapshot.
- Provide JSON exports for ingestion into your SIEM, and CSV for your audit team samples.

5) SOC 2 artifacts and NDAs- We can provide SOC 2 artifacts under a standard NDA; Marissa, please coordinate redaction/NDAs as needed.

I'll join Thursday's call and can bring a short diagram of export flows and the Object Lock setup.

Cheers,
